summary: Reviewed unit RRU-80069e3d3e53 (320 files, LeanPool/@subtrees/8) of Vilin97__lean-pool. Confirmed the exact 320-file scope against the brief. Checked the smallest file (LeanPool/PFR/Mathlib/Order/Interval/Finset/Defs.lean, 350 bytes) and the largest (LeanPool/IsoGraph/Canon/Equivariance.lean, 240562 bytes), both genuine mathematical content. Sampled a representative file from each of 13 top-level subproject directories plus 7 further subdirectories (ChannelCapacity, Circuitlib/Circuit, Clawristotle, FiniteGraphFundamentalGroup, GKPCarry, MinModulusUniqueMultisetSum, Neukirch, PythagoreanPolynomialParametrization, ZetaH123, plus PFR and ZhangYeungInequality nested paths), all genuine declarations. Ran the declaration-keyword grep over the full scope (theorem|lemma|def |structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|elab|noncomputable): 0 of 320 files had no match. Because that scan can be defeated by prose docstrings that happen to contain keyword substrings, separately searched the scope for files named Basic.lean/Main.lean/Prelude.lean/Defs.lean/Definitions.lean/All.lean (28 matches) and read every one of those not already sampled in full: LeanPool/MRiscX/Basic.lean, LeanPool/SNumbers/BasicResults.lean, LeanPool/KasamiCyclicAdditive/Prelude.lean, LeanPool/KasamiCyclicAdditive/Main.lean, LeanPool/PFR/Main.lean, LeanPool/SNumbers/SNumbers/Basic.lean, LeanPool/PythagoreanPolynomialParametrization/Main.lean, LeanPool/Clawristotle/Defs.lean, LeanPool/Circuitlib/Circuit/Belnap/Basic.lean, LeanPool/Circuitlib/Circuit/Category/Basic.lean, LeanPool/ZhangYeungInequality/Prelude.lean. Of these, 4 (MRiscX/Basic.lean, SNumbers/BasicResults.lean, KasamiCyclicAdditive/Prelude.lean, PythagoreanPolynomialParametrization/Main.lean) are pure import-aggregator files (module header, import/public import statements, docstring, optional @[expose] public section, zero declarations); under FILTER-007 these are retained navigation data, not excluded. The remaining files in that list contain substantial genuine proved mathematical content (e.g. PFR/Main.lean proves the Polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa conjecture itself) despite aggregator-style names. Ran a case-insensitive junk-signal grep for lorem ipsum|dummy dummy|XXX unimplemented over the full scope: 0 matches. Ran a TODO|FIXME|XXX grep over the full scope: 24 files had 1-5 matches each, all isolated comments inside files already confirmed or evidently substantial (e.g. PFR/MoreRuzsaDist.lean, PFR/ForMathlib/Entropy/RuzsaDist.lean, MRiscX/Hoare/HoareRules.lean, MRiscX/Tactics/CodeProofTactics.lean, Neukirch/HilbertRamificationTheory.lean), consistent with ordinary development TODO comments in real mathematical source, not placeholder or stub files.
